hook: Figure's humanoid robots just walked the pit lane at the *Las Vegas Grand Prix*
caption:
Figure brought its F.03 humanoid robots to the Formula 1 Las Vegas Grand Prix in a partnership with T-Mobile, wearing magenta race vests.
Figure CEO Brett Adcock posted two of them walking side by side down the pit lane.
Neither company has said what the robots did for fans, how many were there, or whether they were walking on their own or remote controlled.
